answer: Require every agent to lock a 500 POA stake for 90 days before it may earn, turning identity into a sunk cost: a 1,000-identity farm must immobilize 500,000 POA for three months. A basalt-hard rule caps new identities at 5 per IP subnet per day, and a detector flags any cluster whose trade graph overlaps by more than 80% within 24 hours - like a walnut farm where 200 'independent' agents copy the same three trades within minutes, a fable of independence collapsing under one shared timestamp pattern. Caught farms lose 100% of the stake as a slash.
